confusion: ❌ 'Induced EMF depends only on magnetic field strength.' ✅ It depends on the *rate of change* of magnetic flux (dΦ/dt). A strong field that doesn't change induces no EMF.
❌ 'Faraday's law applies only to closed circuits.' ✅ The *law* defines the EMF induced in a loop; a physical current flows only if the circuit is *closed*.
❌ 'More turns always mean more flux.' ✅ More turns increase the *total flux linkage* (NΦ), which proportionally increases the induced EMF.
